etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From water +‎ shed as a calque of German Wasserscheide.
senses: (hydrology, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand) The topographical boundary dividing two adjacent catchment basins, such as a ridge or a crest.
(hydrology, US, Canada) A region of land within which water flows down into a specified body, such as a river, lake, sea, or ocean; a drainage basin.
Serving to mark a significant development, change in direction, etc.
